29557.meaning1: then after that; then next; from then on

29558.commentary: (DNa) tato paraṃ n'ānussaratī'ti tato pubbenivāsā paraṃ na sarati, sarituṃ asakkonto tattha ṭhatvā diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti.

examples.text: agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte taṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, tato paraṃ n'ānussarati.
tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

diso disaṃ yaṃ taṃ kayirā, verī vā pana verinaṃ, micchāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, pāpiyo naṃ tato kare.
